categories.main_business_segments: Tongyu Heavy Industry primarily operates in high-end equipment manufacturing and new energy sectors, focusing on wind power equipment, steel casting, nuclear power equipment, aerospace, marine engineering, and high-end forged steel components. The company has a strategic layout called '1122' covering aviation, high-end equipment, overseas and marine engineering, new energy, and new materials. It provides core components for large-scale equipment in energy power (including wind, hydro, thermal, nuclear), petrochemical, shipbuilding, metallurgy, aerospace, mining, and cement industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates smelting, forging, casting, welding, heat treatment, machining, and coating into a comprehensive R&D and manufacturing platform. It emphasizes three core processes: forging, casting, and welding. Advanced technologies include CNC composite deep hole drilling, large-scale ductile iron casting molds, fiber-integrated magnetic yoke forgings, and high-strength, high-toughness wind power main shafts. It also develops specialized processes for large steel ingots, vacuum casting, ultrasonic flaw detection, and modular wind power equipment manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tongyu Heavy Industry serves major customers in the wind power industry, nuclear power sector, shipbuilding and marine engineering, aerospace, metallurgy, mining, and petrochemical industries. Key customers include leading domestic power enterprises and global mining giants like Metso. The company also supplies to nuclear power engineering companies and has expanded into overseas markets, particularly in Europe and offshore wind power sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main production bases in Shandong Province (Dezhou, Yucheng). It has expanded overseas markets, notably in Europe and offshore wind power. Subsidiaries and branches exist in Guangdong (Zhuhai), Jiangsu (Changzhou), Shandong (Jinan, Dezhou), Guizhou, Shanxi, and Australia. Overseas revenue accounted for 40.75% of total revenue in 2024, showing significant growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tongyu Heavy Industry operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of core components and modules for high-end equipment and new energy products. It provides key forged and cast parts, structural components, and complete sets of equipment to OEMs and system integrators in energy, shipbuilding, and aerospace industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development, focusing on upgrading product structures and expanding high-value-added products. R&D efforts target wind power casting quality improvement, large steel ingot forging, nuclear power equipment, aerospace materials, and modular wind power equipment. It emphasizes digital transformation, organizational reform, and talent development to enhance competitiveness and accelerate overseas market expansion, especially in offshore wind power and aerospace sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Tongyu Heavy Industry generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products, including forged and cast components, modular wind power equipment, and complete sets of high-end equipment. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with customized orders, serving industrial clients domestically and internationally. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but product sales dominate revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic high-end equipment and new energy supplier with comprehensive manufacturing capabilities. It competes in sectors such as wind power components, nuclear power equipment, and marine engineering. Tongyu Heavy Industry has achieved certifications from multiple international classification societies and is recognized as a qualified supplier to major nuclear and power enterprises, indicating a strong competitive position in China and growing presence overseas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tongyu Heavy Industry reported operating revenue of approximately 6.15 billion RMB, a 5.94% increase from 2023, but net profit attributable to shareholders declined significantly by 79.73% to about 41.4 million RMB due to intensified price competition in the wind power sector. The company’s total assets were around 15.5 billion RMB with stable equity. Overseas revenue grew by 62.11%, reaching 40.75% of total revenue, reflecting rapid international market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tongyu Heavy Industry emphasizes its integrated manufacturing platform combining smelting, forging, casting, welding, and machining to provide comprehensive, high-quality core components and modular equipment. Its unique value lies in the ability to supply large-scale, high-precision, and customized products for critical industries like wind power, nuclear power, and aerospace. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, quality assurance system, and strategic focus on innovation and overseas markets differentiate it from competitors.
